batches.rss_scope: OS process high-water mark for this sole batch worker, including witness, PK decode, Prove, Verify and export; not Prove-only interval peak
batches.witness_scope: Independent R1CS synthesis and satisfaction check; the high-level Prove call also internally synthesizes, so do not add diagnostic Witness time as an exclusive Prove subcomponent.
